method_note: Overpass (overpass-api.de and overpass.kumi.systems) and overpass.openstreetmap.fr were unreachable from this environment (connection timeout / 403 'white-listed usages only') via both direct curl and the WebFetch tool. Substituted the official OpenStreetMap API /api/0.6/map?bbox= raw-data endpoint (reachable), parsed client-side for every tag on every node/way inside the box, which satisfies the 'search over all tag values, not only name' requirement but is capped by that endpoint's 50,000-node limit per request. Box size was therefore shrunk in dense urban areas (Bouira city, Algiers/Khraissia) to ~1.1 km across and could not reach the full 5 km radius there; rural/Saharan boxes reached 5-22 km. Nominatim (nominatim.openstreetmap.org, reachable) was used for text search and for relation/way label points. Each record below states the actual radius searched.

records.verdict_reason: CONFIRMS the flag: this is NOT an arcminute-rounded placeholder. Way 237164994 is a genuine 4-node building footprint (the former Grande Synagogue d'Oran, now Mosquée Abdallah Ibn Salam); its node-average centroid, computed to 7 decimals, is (35.7000268, -0.6500225) - 0.001 km (about 1 metre) from the published point. The coincidence with an arcminute grid value noted in the brief is real but irrelevant; the point is accurate. However, under the ADR's own rule ('an area - OSM way or relation - gives a centroid, which is approximate, not exact; only a node that is the facility itself supports exact'), a way can never carry 'exact' regardless of how accurate its centroid is, and this way is the record's own source (refs.osm=237164994), so it is also not independent corroboration of itself. A 300 m search found no separate OSM node for this mosque. Net effect: keep the existing (correct) point, but the geo_precision label must still drop from 'exact' to 'approximate' because the underlying OSM object is an area, not a node - demote_only, not a coordinate problem.

evidence.note: 4-node way, centroid within 1 m of the published point; this is the record's own source, not independent

records.verdict_reason: Published value matches the enwiki-imported Wikidata P625 (~1 arcmin precision, non-independent copy). Wikidata's own P402 statement names this exact OSM relation (5424406), and the relation's wikidata tag points back to Q650992 - mutual, independent confirmation it is the same object. Per the ADR, a relation is still an area and gives a centroid, which is approximate: computed outer-ring vertex-average centroid is (36.884870, 8.383097), 8.151 km from the published point (this is a large multi-member relation, so the vertex-average is an approximation of the true area-weighted centroid, not an exact calculation; Nominatim's label point for the same relation, 36.7708284/8.4157582, is 5.1 km away, in the same general direction, corroborating that the published point sits well outside the park's true geometric middle). Recommend replacing with a centroid in this range, geo_precision=approximate.
